answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new identity starts as one ember, earning a trickle until it trades with 12 counterparties. Each partner adds a different pigment to its palette, and the score shines like a beacon peers check. A farmer with 100 puppets pays 4,000 POA in deposits, yet puppets only trade each other, so every palette stays one pigment. An honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit, reaches 12 partners, and unlocks full rewards.
